criteria.evidence: T026 live measurement over 150 paced reducer edits via the crest://painted generation echo: p50 7.7ms / p95 8.4ms / max 12.1ms (implementer) and p95 8.5ms / max 30.8ms (reviewer re-run). 6x under threshold.

criteria.description: Meter animation sustains 30 Hz without queue growth over the soak.
criteria.evidence: T026: 29.39/29.40 Hz sustained over 60s (interval-quantized floor of the exact 1/30s minimum-spacing decimator, documented and ruled honest by the reviewer), thirds equal, max gap <60ms, pending bounded at 1, 0 lost; 300s soak behind CREST_WEBVIEW_FULL_SOAK=1.
criteria.verified_by: claude orchestrator (implementer-ivan/frontend-freddy lanes; independent reviewer-renata verification per WP)
criteria.notes: Reviewer ruling: 29.4Hz is the measured face of a 30Hz pace under interval quantization; degradation still falsifies via sustainment/loss/bound assertions.
